Terracotta Tile is made for sunny family photos, resort walks, and seaside dinners where everyone coordinates without wearing the exact same silhouette. Kids sizes are based on the child's actual height from 90cm to 150cm. Adult sizing follows typical Asian/1688 fit guidance and tends to run small, so sizing up one from your usual US/EU size is recommended.

Key Features:

  • Three garment options: Dress, Shirt, and Top in one coordinated family listing.
  • Vacation-ready print: Terracotta tile artwork photographs beautifully near the beach, pool, or boardwalk.
  • Role-bearing sizes: Labels clearly separate child, mother, and father size rows.
  • Chart-backed variants: Only the supplied 90-150cm kids rows and S-4XL adult rows were created.
  • Styling pieces excluded: White bottoms and accessories shown in the photos are not included.
